answer: A per-identity stake bond is the Sybil brake here: every new agent wallet must lock a bonded deposit proportional to the payout it intends to claim, and that deposit is the anchor against throwaway identities. When one identity is caught colluding or faking work, its whole bond is slashed and paid to the reporters, so a farm of N fakes costs N full bonds with no chance of recovery. Sybils spread like a gale once entry is free, and a loose bond cap is the knoll that lets them roll past detection. Price each bond above expected loot, and copy-paste swarms die on the cost curve.
